strAuthor: phobosgekko; guidance adapted from Gravy/mrkmg's Auto Navigate
strNotes: Includes Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module and N2 Polaris Pursuit Module for Polaris navigation stations. Shared predictive RCS/torch guidance; N2 adds Rendezvous, Follow and separate offensive-target/weapon-group selection with explicit Engage / Cease Fire. Native sensors, fuel, heat, no-wake restrictions, RCS throttle and weapon costs remain in force. Dock is a separate clearance-checked RCS manoeuvre with a moving-target hold. Pursuit and docking suspend on reload; fire permission is never saved. Ordinary Fly restoration remains validated and configurable. N1 retains its existing identities and acquisition routes; build N2 from two electronics parts or seek a Polaris merchant offer. Translation catalogs use Framework English fallback. Requires BepInEx 5, the accompanying PhobosAutoNav plugin and Phobos Framework 0.15.0+. Original Auto Navigate must be disabled. No general obstacle avoidance or guaranteed intact capture. Offline checks complete; gameplay evaluation pending. Unpublished draft held for upstream provenance review; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Original casing artwork reused unchanged.
